about: Lacombe is a city in central Alberta between Red Deer and Edmonton, in parkland farming country along Highway 2A. Historic brick Main Street, the Canadian University College / Burman University campus area, and a role as an agricultural service centre define the community. About 14,000 people live in Lacombe.
